title: Get available features
description: The product features the organization's plans include, with any overrides applied. The cheapest read in the billing API, readable by any member. Use it to check whether a feature such as group analytics or white-labelling is available before suggesting it. Beta: behind the organization-billing-api flag, and the output shape may change while it is.

methodDocumentation.text: In beta: the organization billing API is behind the organization-billing-api feature flag and answers 403 without it, so ask support for access. Its shapes may change while it is in beta.
